Name: Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild - 1.6 ready
Author: ivylovesbirds
TagLine: Ornithologist's Guild brings a totally new birding experience to Stardew Valley. Do you have what it takes to be Pelican Town's next great birder?
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/grXQLR3.png)

**Ornithologist's Guild brings a totally new birding experience to Stardew Valley, complete with overhauled bird mechanics, bird feeders and baths, seasonal birds, nests and fledglings, a progression system, a new location and shop, an NPC with a tragic past, and sooo much more! Do you have what it takes to be Pelican Town's next great birder?**


![](https://i.imgur.com/bupGbFL.png)

Grab a pair of your trusty binoculars and get exploring! Attract the rarest birds to your farm by building bird feeders that hold a variety of bird food. Craft bird baths for your feathered friends to splash and play in. Make your own bird food by processing your crops through the birdseed huller. Scour the sky, ground, and water for new birds, each with their own unique behaviour and sound.


![](https://i.imgur.com/eN12xzf.png)

Birds seek out the perfect tree, build a cozy nest, and raise their sweet little babies. If you're lucky, you'll even catch the fledge! A keen eye in the spring is all you need to experience the cutest spectacle Pelican Town's nature has to offer.


![](https://i.imgur.com/2HOEeyV.png)

Each season and location means exciting new birdwatching opportunities! Watch for elusive desert birds, cold-loving winter birds, and marsh birds who gather in flocks by the mountain lake. Keep track of the birds you've seen, where and when you've seen them, and fun facts about them in your very own Life List. And when you've spotted them all, download a new bird pack! Are you a modder? Add custom perches to your maps or make your own bird packs using a simple API inspired by Content Patcher.

### Bird Packs
-   [Eurasian Birds by Mazout](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26599)
-   [Arrbyte's Birds](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22713)
-   [GCWA's Warbler Pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26976)
-   *Your bird pack here!*

![](https://i.imgur.com/fbUpO2r.png)

Explore a detailed and quirky shop selling bird feeders, baths, birdseed, binoculars, and more. Get to know a mysterious new NPC with a tragic past, but be prepared for a surprise! You'll find all this and more below The Wizard's house in Cindersap Forest!


![](https://i.imgur.com/PJD8W7Y.png)

### FAQ
**"Is the mod safe to add/remove/update mid-game?"**
Yes!

**"How do I use the binoculars and life list?"**
Press the **use tool** key (`C` or left click) while holding the binoculars or Life List to use them. Make sure you're outside and near birds.

**"Why do bird feeders produce rotting plants?"**
Bird feeders need to be cleaned regularly, just like in real life!

**"Is multiplayer supported?"**
Yes! Each player maintains their own Life List and sees different birds. Syncing each individual bird between players would be a massive undertaking.

**"Help! There's a tree in the middle of the Ornithologist's Guild building!"**
Use the [unofficial version of the Reset Terrain Features tool](https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-64#post-43678)﻿.

**"Help! How do I get to know Kyle?"**
[spoiler]
Explore his room, then come back early in the morning before he opens the shop.
[/spoiler]
**"Easter eggs?"**
[spoiler]
Thoroughly explore Kyle's shop!
[/spoiler]
**"How can I help save birds IRL?"**
The world has lost nearly 3 _billion_ birds since 1970. Going vegan is by far the single most impactful thing you can do to help prevent habitat and biodiversity loss, avian flu outbreak, and more. For information on other ways you can help, [click here](https://www.birds.cornell.edu/home/seven-simple-actions-to-help-birds/).

### Compatibility
Ornithologist's Guild has been developed mindfully to be compatible with other mods, safe to add and remove mid-game, and performant so it doesn't introduce lag.
- **🟢 Compatible:** Stardew Valley Expanded
- **🟢 Compatible:** East Scarp
- **🟢 Compatible:** Ridgeside Village
- **🟢 Compatible:** New Update Village
- **🟢 Compatible:** Stardew Valley Reimagined 3 (thanks @lemurkat!)
- **🟢 Compatible:** Automate
- **🟡 Warning:** New NPC - Cecilia: in the mod options of ﻿New NPC - Cecilia, choose Cecilia's Town Map
- Other mods: likely compatible unless bird code or the bottom left of the Forest map have been patched
- If you run into compatibility issues, please file a bug!
